image_description: A dark green, cylindrical plastic rain barrel positioned outdoors against a beige vinyl-sided house wall. The barrel sits on a raised concrete block base. A white downspout extends from the roof above into the top of the barrel. A spigot is visible near the bottom front, connected to a green garden hose that snakes across the ground. Shadows from the siding and foliage are cast across the barrel.
